headline: 103°F heat warning — onions due, potatoes peaking.
weather_notes: Work before 9 AM through Sunday — Extreme Heat Warning active through Aug 2 at 9 PM MDT with 103°F today and 101°F Sunday.
Run both zones this morning — 2 days without irrigation at 103°F exceeds the 1-day heat threshold.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds through midday — 42-day transplants at 101–103°F risk sunscald and blossom drop through Sunday.
Check potato bags for moisture after zones run — container soil dries 2–3× faster than raised beds under extreme heat.
